name: Broken and Mended
source:
Daniel goes to his friend Charlie's birthday party, and finds out that his friend may hiding his personal problems from him. But Daniel is dealing with problems of his own...

[From [url=https://ivycrowidk.itch.io/broken-and-mended]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
丹尼尔前去参加好友查理的生日派对，却发现好友似乎正瞒着自己独自承受私人困扰。然而，丹尼尔自己也正深陷各自的烦恼之中……
